✨ Border Horse Slaughter Rescue documents the journey of saving, rehabilitating, and rehoming horses in danger — including abused and slaughter-bound horses.

Our mission is to:
🐴 Rescue horses from harmful environments
🌿 Provide medical care and emotional rehabilitation
💛 Give them love, trust, and a second chance
🏡 Help each horse find a safe, forever home

On this channel, you’ll find:
🔹 Real rescue missions
🔹 Full rehabilitation progress
🔹 Emotional before-and-after stories
🔹 Daily farm life & horse care
🔹 Successful adoption journeys

💬 Your subscription helps save more horses.
👉 Hit Subscribe to join our rescue mission!
